sections.text: Obaveštavamo putnike da autobusi na linijama 68, 71, 76, 77, 78, 79, 80, 81, 84 saobraćaju redovnim trasama 14. 8. od  17 časova. Uslovi za povratak na redovne trase stekli su se završetkom radova u Karađorđevoj ulici u Sremskoj Kamenici.

text_translations.en: We inform passengers that buses on lines 68, 71, 76, 77, 78, 79, 80, 81, 84 operate on regular routes on August 14 from 5 p.m. The conditions for returning to regular routes were achieved with the completion of works in Karađorđeva Street in Sremska Kamenica.

title: Linije 6, 11B – Povratak na redovne trase na Beogradskom keju

sections.text: U skladu sa obaveštenjem izvođača radova na rekonstrukciji poveznog voda na Beogradskom keju, obaveštavamo putnike da će se 16. 8. 2026. godine steći uslovi za ukidanje privremene izmene trasa linija 6 i 11B. Autobusi će se vratiti na redovnu trasu odmah nakon puštanja saobraćajnica u redovan saobraćaj.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the notification of the contractor for the reconstruction of the connecting line on the Belgrade Quay, we inform passengers that on August 16, 2026, the conditions will be met for the cancellation of the temporary changes to the routes of lines 6 and 11B. The buses will return to the regular route immediately after the roads are opened to regular traffic.

title_translations.en: Lines 6, 11B – Return to regular routes on Belgrade Quay

title: Linija 24 - Privremena izmena trase u Kovilju

sections.text: Obaveštavamo putnike da će od 13. 8. do 28. 8. 2026. godine privremeno biti izmenjena trasa autobuske linije broj 24. U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, do izmene će doći zbog rekonstrukcije Ulice Branka Bajića, na delu od Ulice Petra Drapšina i Ulice Laze Kostića do Ulice kralja Petra prvog u Kovilju.

text_translations.en: We inform passengers that from August 13 to August 28, 2026, the route of bus line number 24 will be temporarily changed. In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, the change will occur due to the reconstruction of Branko Bajić Street, on the part from Petra Drapšin Street and Laza Kostić Street to Kralja Petra prvič Street in Kovilje.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici ulica Branka Bajića i Petra Drapšina autobusi će skretati desno u Ulicu Petra Drapšina, saobraćati pravo do Kralja Petra prvog, levo ulicom Kralja Petra prvog do Ulice Laze Kostića i desno nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Branko Bajića and Petra Drapšina streets, the buses will turn right into Petra Drapšina Street, drive straight to Kralja Petra the first, left along Kralja Petra the first to Laza Kostić Street and continue on the right on the regular route.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici ulica Laze Kostića i Kralja Petra prvog autobusi će saobraćati levo Ulicom kralja Petra prvog do Ulice Petra Drapšina, skretati desno u Ulicu Petra Drapšina, nastavljati pravo do Ulice Branka Bajića, levo Ulicom Branka Bajića i dalje redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Laza Kostića and Kralja Petra 1st streets, buses will drive left along Kralja Petra 1st Street to Petra Drapšina Street, turn right into Petra Drapšina Street, continue straight to Branka Bajić Street, left along Branka Bajić Street and continue along the regular route.

title_translations.en: Line 24 - Temporary route change in Kovilje

title: Linija 14 – Privremeno ukidanje stajališta Veternik-Kralja Petra prvog

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve,  od 11. 8. do 25. 8. 2026. godine privremeno se ukida autobusko stajalište Veternik-Kralja Petra prvog 97 (ispred auto salona „KIA“), smer sa Sajlova. Navedeno stajalište neće biti u funkciji zbog izvođenja građevinskih radova.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from August 11 to August 25, 2026, the Veternik-Kralja Petra first bus stop at 97 (in front of the "KIA" car showroom), direction from Sajlov, will be temporarily closed. The said stop will not be in operation due to construction works.

title_translations.en: Line 14 - Temporary cancellation of the Veternik-Kralja Petar I stop

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve  određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuskih linija broj 68, 71, 76, 77, 78, 79, 80, 81 i 84  u Karađorđevoj ulici u Sremskoj Kamenici. Izmenjen režim saobraćanja linija važi od 6. 8. do 23. 8. 2026.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, a temporary change in the route of bus lines 68, 71, 76, 77, 78, 79, 80, 81 and 84 in Karađorđeva Street in Sremska Kamenica is determined. The changed traffic regime of the lines is valid from 6 August to 23 August 2026.

text_translations.en: From the Trg Zmaj Jove/Ive Lola Ribara intersection, buses drive left along Ive Lola Ribara street, then turn right onto Paragovski put, left onto Ledinački put and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Obaveštavamo korisnike usluge prevoza na liniji 16 da je zbog usklađivanja sa potrebama građana polazak u 15:10 časova u aktuelnom redu vožnje pomeren na 16:10 časova.

text_translations.en: We inform the users of the transportation service on line 16 that, due to compliance with the needs of citizens, the departure at 3:10 p.m. in the current timetable has been moved to 4:10 p.m.

sections.text: JGSP „Novi Sad“ obaveštava putnike da će od 22. juna 2026. godine  autobusi saobraćati po organizaciji prevoza za letnji period. Novi red vožnje podrazumeva vremenske korekcije autobuskih polazaka,  koje su usklađene sa potrebama korisnika usluga prevoza u narednim mesecima i očekivanim smanjenjem broja putnika zbog korišćenja godišnjih odmora i letnjeg raspusta.

text_translations.en: JGSP "Novi Sad" informs passengers that from June 22, 2026, buses will run according to the transportation organization for the summer period. The new timetable implies time corrections of bus departures, which are aligned with the needs of users of transportation services in the coming months and the expected decrease in the number of passengers due to the use of annual vacations and summer vacation.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Tsar Lazar Boulevard/Stražilovska, buses will continue straight along Tsar Lazar Boulevard, then along the Raid Victims Quay to the intersection with Maksima Gorki Street, and continue along the previously changed route due to works on the Quay.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from April 6, 2026, until the completion of the first phase of works on the reconstruction of the connecting hot water pipeline GRS-TO JUG from Varadinski bridge to Marka Miljanova Street, the routes of bus lines number 6, 11A and 11B will be temporarily changed.

Departures to "Danubius" will not operate.

title: Red vožnje na vanrednim polascima Železnička stanica Petrovaradin - Centar od 14. 01.

sections.text:
Kao ispomoć redovnim linijama 3, 9, 60, 61, 62 i 63 i dalje su na snazi vanredni, direktni polasci autobusa sa autobuskog stajališta „Petrovaradin/Železnička stanica“ u Preradovićevoj ulici (oba smera). Autobusi iz Petrovaradina do centra saobraćaju do stajališta kod SNP-a, a iz centra do Petrovaradina sa polaznog stajališta linije 12 u Šafarikovoj ulici ().

Duž cele trase vanredni polasci u oba smera saobraćaju direktno, ne koristeći ostala stajališta.

Shodno ugovoru sa „Srbijavozom“, na navedenoj relaciji prevoz je BESPLATAN.

text_translations.en:
In addition to the regular lines 3, 9, 60, 61, 62 and 63, extraordinary, direct bus departures from the "Petrovaradin/Railway Station" bus stop in Preradovićeva Street (both directions) are still in force. Buses from Petrovaradin to the center run to the bus stop near SNP, and from the center to Petrovaradin from the departure stop of line 12 in Šafarikova street ().

Along the entire route, extraordinary departures in both directions operate directly, without using other stops.

According to the contract with "Srbijavoz", transportation on the mentioned route is FREE.

title: Linija 9A privremeno preusmerena do okretnice u Petrovaradinu

sections.text:
Zbog preusmeravanja železničkog saobraćaja na Železničku stanicu Petrovaradin, obaveštavamo putnike da je zbog rasterećenja postojećih linija autobusa, linija 9A u smeru od Alibegovca produžena do petrovaradinske okretnice linija 3 i 9, odakle dalje saobraća redovnom trasom do Novog naselja. 

Podsećamo putnike da je na relaciji Šafarikova ulica - Železnička stanica Petrovaradin uvedena vanredna linija na kojoj je prevoz BESPLATAN, te da su građanima pored gradskih linija za prevoz do Železničke stanice Petrovaradin na raspolaganju i međumesne linije 60, 61, 62 i 63 koje kreću sa Međumesne autobuske stanice.

text_translations.en:
Due to the rerouting of railway traffic to the Petrovaradin Railway Station, we inform passengers that due to the relief of existing bus lines, line 9A in the direction of Alibegovec has been extended to the Petrovaradin turnpike of lines 3 and 9, from where it runs on a regular route to New Settlement. 

We remind passengers that an extraordinary line has been introduced on the route Šafarikova Street - Petrovaradin Railway Station, where transport is FREE, and that in addition to the city lines for transport to the Petrovaradin Railway Station, intercity lines 60, 61, 62 and 63 are available to citizens, which depart from the Intercity Bus Station.

title_translations.en: Line 9A temporarily diverted to the turnpike in Petrovaradin
